== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-commandernemet-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Nemet (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 25 January 2018): Same words. A full card image with the text box set again and a white italic “E” in the black lower border; the bronze disc is gone.

The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
